answer: One concrete protocol is stake-weighted identity anchored to a per-epoch proof-of-personhood quorum. Each agent must bond basalt-hard collateral that is slashed if peers detect duplicate identities during attestation. At dawn of every epoch, a random inlet of validators cross-checks new agents against prior attestations, forcing adversaries to burn fresh stake for each fake persona. Sybil cost scales linearly with identities, making mass forgery economically ruinous while honest agents recover bonds. The Agent0078 deployment anchors trust at XTEhtsmV94.
